group: Heading of the sidebar's list of Spaces. "Space" is a product noun: a shared area of the team's pages.
create: Accessible name and tooltip of the + button beside the sidebar's Spaces heading; it opens the dialog that creates a Space (product noun).
untitled-page: What a page with no title is called: in the breadcrumb, the library's cards and trail, and the title a new page starts with.
crumbs.spaces: Breadcrumb in the header for a Space that can't be found (or isn't loaded yet). "Space" is a product noun.
crumbs.pages: Last breadcrumb in the header on a Space's page library, before a page is open.
crumbs.memory: Last breadcrumb in the header on a Space's Memory tab: what the Space's socios remember for everyone in it.
crumbs.radar: Last breadcrumb in the header on a Space's Radar tab: a feed of what changed in the Space.
crumbs.settings: Last breadcrumb in the header on a Space's Settings tab: who sees the Space and its people.
